summary: Malaysia's Permanent Mission to the UN circulated Note Verbale HA 26/20 dated 29 July 2020, responding to China's note CML/14/2019 on Malaysia's continental shelf submission; it rejected in its entirety the content of China's note, rejected China's claims to historic rights or other sovereign rights and jurisdiction within the nine-dash line as exceeding the limits of UNCLOS, and stated that China's claim to the maritime features in the South China Sea has no basis under international law.

location_name: about 80-81 nautical miles off Tok Bali, Kelantan
summary: Late on 16 August 2020 an MMEA patrol boat approaching two Vietnamese fishing boats for inspection about 80 nautical miles off Tok Bali, Kelantan, fired warning shots and then opened fire after the boats rammed it and crew threw petrol bombs, killing one Vietnamese fisherman; the other 19 crew were detained, and MMEA chief Mohd Zubil Mat Som said his men acted to protect their lives and national sovereignty.
actors: Malaysian Maritime Enforcement Agency (MMEA); Director-General Mohd Zubil Mat Som
reasoning: Warning shots, lethal fire and detention during fisheries enforcement against another claimant's boats are physical imposition of punishment; coercive (a coder may consider 'force' given the fatality). The location is Malaysia's undisputed peninsular EEZ, not a contested area; Vietnam protested and sought an investigation.
